tasks.summary:
这是一个小型网站，访客可以注册。

首页和注册页的共享导航提供 "Home"(role=link)、"Booking"(role=link)、"Travel guides"(role=link)、"My 12306"(role=link)、"简体中文"(role=button) 和 "Contact us"(role=link)，可见文案与参考图片完全一致。账户入口控件及其行为见 REQ-1。每个页面的页脚提供 "Privacy Policy"(role=link) 和 "Cookie Statement"(role=link)，可见文案和可访问名称相同。名称重复的控件通过其语义位置区分，例如注册协议区域与页脚。这里明确了参考控件的展示和交互身份.

description_markdown:
## First Competition

Implement the published Ticket Booking requirements and verify the resulting application against its executable tests.
flow: Upload an agent snapshot or select a built-in one.
Compile the large requirement into smaller runnable modules.
Run the GitHub-style and spreadsheet-style tasks in order.
Inspect evidence and refine the system until the output is stable.
rules: Treat the requirement document as the source of truth.
Keep changes small enough to verify each step.
Use the task artifacts to explain what your agent changed.
